aiNotes.text: 3+ years is fine if not stated as strictly required

No commercial experience, but 3 years of self-directed practice: building and shipping own product, understands metrics and product thinking, has real problem-solving experience. Treat this as comparable to junior-to-middle practical skill level, not as zero experience.

If a posting is graded '3-6 years' (e.g. on hh.ru) but the requirements text does not explicitly say commercial/professional experience is mandatory, treat experience as not strict and show the vacancy if skills otherwise match.
